cover_prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / ads-marketing.
Asset type: final square Steam Workshop mod cover illustration. Create a NEW search-themed composition while retaining the exact character identity from reference 1 and the white/lavender series look, typography hierarchy and refined anime illustration from reference 2. Reference 1 is the canonical character identity, not a composition target; reference 2 is only the approved series-art and title styling reference, not a refrigerator scene to copy.
Scene: warm sunlight through the window of a rustic post-apocalyptic storage room. The same elegant young adult dragon woman kneels beside an open wooden storage chest and a practical backpack, examining a small useful inventory object through a large readable magnifying glass. Visually communicate finding belongings in backpacks and nearby containers. A few neatly arranged supplies, wood grain and soft lavender sparkles; restrained details that remain legible at thumbnail scale.
Character invariants: same slender face, gentle lilac eyes, long silver-white hair, paired light ivory segmented dragon horns, pale lilac membranous dragon wings, long white scaled dragon tail. Preserve all identity traits, similar mature body proportions to the references, white and lavender palette, rose-shaped hair ornament, ribbons and fine floral embroidery. Outfit may be a practical elegant white and lavender adventuring dress with a short shoulder cape and small pouches. Wings and tail must be visibly present. No blue spirit needed.
Composition: square balanced polished cover, character and magnifying glass clearly readable; open chest and backpack prominent; comfortable top title area. Match the reference-2 series quality and graceful border motifs but make a distinct storage-search scene. No full game UI, no extra people.
Text verbatim, accurately lettered with clear hierarchy: large Chinese title "蘇清的搜索增强"; smaller English subtitle "SuQing's Search Enhancement". Elegant white/lavender serif lettering with rose-and-wing ornament, readable at 512px. No other writing. Do not add any game version number, build number, mod version, multiplayer/single-player label, watermark or logos.
Deliver one polished square image, opaque background.
icon_prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: separately designed small game-mod icon, a single square transparent-background emblem for "SuQing's Search Enhancement". This is a NEW icon composition, never a shrunken or cropped cover.
Primary request: one bold, instantly readable magnifying glass inspecting a small lavender-and-white storage chest/backpack emblem. A graceful white dragon's curved scaled tail wraps around the lower rim, with two small pale ivory horns and tiny pale-lavender wing shapes integrated into the badge silhouette. Evoke the same white/lavender dragon identity and floral rose accent of the reference character without rendering a full person or any small face.
Reference images: canonical dragon character is an identity/palette source only; the approved cover is a palette/series source only.
Style: polished anime-fantasy UI inventory icon, hand-painted with crisp clean contours, simple large forms, restrained soft highlights, silver-white and lavender main colors, subtle violet outline and one warm brass detail on magnifier. Lens and chest remain recognizable at 64x64. Avoid excessive decoration, tiny objects, detailed scene, complex texture, realistic glass rendering or busy interior.
Composition: centered compact badge, icon fills 85% of square with clear outside padding. One strong diagonally held magnifying glass, simple closed storage chest visible through lens, cohesive silhouette. Actual transparent background outside emblem.
No text, letters, numerals, title, build/version marks, watermark or logos. Provide one clean icon image.
